name: ALL IN 2026
description: Canada's largest AI event, co-organized by Mila and Scale AI. 7,500+ attendees expected in 2026. Covers AI research, enterprise adoption, B2B SaaS, and supply chain innovation. Held at the Palais des Congrès de Montréal.

description: Immersive business + creativity conference. 6,500+ attendees. Part conference, part festival, part participatory experience.

name: Salesforce World Tour Toronto
description: Salesforce's flagship Canadian event. CRM, AI, automation for enterprise. 5,000+ attendees.

name: AWS Summit Canada
description: AWS cloud computing summit. 5,000+ developers, architects, and IT professionals.

name: Dx3 Canada
description: Canada's largest digital marketing & retail tech event. 3,000+ marketers, retailers, and tech innovators.

name: Montreal International Game Summit (MIGS)
description: Premier game development conference in Canada. 2,500+ game developers, publishers, and tech innovators.

name: Shopify dotdev
description: Shopify dotdev is the new name for Shopify's annual developer and partner gathering, previously known as Editions.dev. The 2026 event will take place in Toronto on July 21-22, expanding to two full days. The 2025 Editions.dev event drew over 2,000 developers and partners and was held at the Enercare Centre in Toronto, suggesting a similar venue for 2026. Ticket prices were not explicitly found, but it is a paid event. (https://www.shopify.com/dotdev, https://medium.com/@tentenco/shopify-dot-dev-2026-what-we-know-what-the-winter-26-edition-delivers-and-what-the-community-555445ccd156, https://www.bizbash.com/corporate-events/how-shopify-shook-up-the-traditional-conference-playbook)

name: SaaS North
description: Canada's largest SaaS conference. 2,000+ SaaS leaders, founders, investors. Keynotes, workshops, networking.

name: DigiMarCon Montreal
description: Digital marketing conference Montréal. 1,000+ digital marketers. SEO, social media, content marketing, analytics.

name: Mesh Conference
description: The Mesh Conference is a national innovation event held in Canadian cities, with the next confirmed event in Calgary on April 29-30, 2025 (https://meshconference.com/). Presale tickets for Calgary 2025 are $149, increasing to $349 after March 31st (https://meshconference.com/tickets-mesh/). The event is organized by Moore Carlyle Consulting (https://meshconference.com/). While specific attendance numbers for recent years were not found, the event focuses on digital transformation and innovation, making it relevant to Tech/B2B SaaS/MarTech in Canada.

name: DigiMarCon Ontario
description: Digital marketing conference Ontario. 1,000+ digital marketing professionals.

name: RevStar Summit 2026
description: The RevStar Summit 2026 is an in-person event focused on bridging the commercialization gap in Canada for B2B SaaS, industrial innovation, and digital health. It will take place on June 3, 2026, at The Quay, Toronto, ON. The event is organized by Vasco and Boreal Ventures. Early bird tickets are priced at $395 and $585 (https://revstarsummit.com/).

name: FounderFuel Demo Day
venue: Montreal, QC (Palais des Congrès mentioned in a past event, but not confirmed for future)
organizer: FounderFuel (powered by Real Ventures, Panache Ventures, and Inovia Capital)
description: FounderFuel Demo Day is Canada's biggest Demo Day, hosting over 1,000 members of Canadian tech. It takes place on the eve of Startupfest in Montreal. For 2025, the estimated date is July 8, 2025, and for 2026, it is July 7, 2026. The event is organized by FounderFuel, powered by Real Ventures, Panache Ventures, and Inovia Capital. (Sources: https://founderfuel.com/, https://realventures.com/founderfuel-is-back/, https://www.startupfest.com/)
